notes: KEY DECISIONS. (D1 own-position store) usePositionReporting writes a SEPARATE useOwnPositionStore (zustand) — NOT usePositionStore (which is the server-fed cache of OTHER drivers keyed by driverId for the dispatcher board). Own geolocation is a distinct source; mixing them violates one-writer-per-datum (web-architecture.md). DriverRidePage reads it for RideMapStrip's blue own-pin (the B3c follow-up: ownLat/ownLng were null, now wired). Diagnostika (B-history) will read lastSentAt. (D2 hub invoke seam) Added exported invokeHub(method,...args) to useFleetHub.ts — invokes on the existing /hubs/fleet singleton; returns false (no-op) when not Connected; NEVER builds a second connection (web-realtime single-hub rule). (D3 last-sent advances only on SUCCESS) positionThrottle.ts is a pure shouldSendPosition(candidate,lastSent,now) decider; usePositionReporting commits lastSentRef + lastSuccessAtRef ONLY after invokeHub resolves true. A failed send does not advance the clock -> retry fires AND the 60s stale watchdog triggers when sends genuinely fail (the exact AC). 60s banner + single vibrate are arm-once (vibratedRef), reset on a successful send. Throttle: send >=3000ms elapsed OR moved >25m (strict). (D4 position mount) usePositionReporting + StalePositionBanner hosted by a DriverPositionReporter mounted in DriverLayout (survives /d sub-route changes, same reasoning that hoisted the hub in B3c); gated online = me.status !== 'Offline'; watch stops when offline (battery). (D5 wake lock) useWakeLock feature-detected (no-op where navigator.wakeLock undefined), re-acquires on visibilitychange->visible; mounted on DriverRidePage for order!=null. (D6 limits doc) docs/driver-pwa-limits.md records Android Chrome / iOS Safari foreground-only constraints as DOCUMENTED EXPECTATIONS (not device measurements, explicitly labeled); notes iOS wakeLock >=16.4, background tracking out of scope. B-QUEUE. (D7 always enqueue-then-drain) ONE code path for online+offline: arrive/start/complete/cancelNoShow always transitionQueue.enqueue (key minted ONCE here) then drainQueue immediately. Online -> sent+dequeued in the same call ('success'); offline -> kept ('queued'); definitive 4xx -> drop+reconcile ('stale'). This makes 'key minted at enqueue, preserved across retries' STRUCTURAL. accept/decline are NEVER enqueued (still live-only in B-offer). NOT workbox-background-sync (app-level idb keeps it fake-indexeddb-testable + works with SW disabled in E2E). idb@8.0.3 + fake-indexeddb@6.2.5 already in package.json (no install, no version bump). (D8 F-02 InFlight retryable) classifyReplayOutcome branches on err.body.errors[0].code === 'Idempotency.InFlight' -> 'keep' (retryable), NOT on the 409 status. VERIFIED against api IdempotencyHelper.cs: InFlight + KeyReused 409s write errors:[{name,reason,code}] via WriteErrorResponseAsync so the code lands in body.errors[].code. A terminal-state 409 from the transition itself carries a non-idempotency code -> definitive. (D9 F-03 dequeue rule) keep ONLY on network error (non-ApiResponseError) or 5xx or InFlight-409; EVERY other definitive 2xx/4xx (404 NotEntitled, terminal-409, KeyReused-409, 400) -> drop that order's items + reconcile. drainQueue stops on the first 'keep' to preserve FIFO; on 'reconcile' it removeByOrderId + reconciles once then continues. (D10 B3c-1 real reconcile + rename) a 'stale' outcome now means the queue ALREADY dropped the order's queued items and reconciled via GET /orders/{id} (terminal -> clear store+IDB + go Home; else updateOrder). Renamed DriverRidePage staleNote/setStaleNote -> reconciledNote; fixed the misleading 'B-queue will reroute these' comment. useRideTransition/useCompleteRide XML docs updated to describe actual queue routing, not the old direct-POST 'stale'. (D11 B3c-2 trim) completeForm.validateCompleteForm now trims overrideReason before the >=5 length check (was untrimmed while overrideReason.ts trims — 5 spaces passed validation but got dropped from the payload); added a whitespace-only-rejected test. (D12 BLOCKER fixed after advisor) reconnect-drain HOISTED to DriverLayout. Originally mounted only in DriverRidePage, but a queued complete/no-show navigates Home and unmounts the ride page -> a reconnect while on Home (or an app restart with a persisted queue) would never replay -> breaks B-queue's FIFO-replay-on-reconnect AC + B-e2e AC#5. Split useTransitionQueue into useQueuePendingCount() (subscribe-only, any screen) + useQueueReplayOnReconnect() (drain effect, layout-only), wrapped in a DriverQueueBar mounted in DriverLayout (survives sub-routes; renders the PendingBadge wherever the driver lands). (D13 single-drain guard) drainQueue serializes concurrent calls via a chained promise (not coalescing — a just-enqueued item still gets attempted in its own drain) so the enqueue-time drain + the reconnect drain never peek the same head twice (avoids spurious InFlight churn); test asserts maxConcurrent===1. (D14 go-Home-on-queued-complete) a queued (offline) complete navigates Home optimistically with a 'Odešle se po připojení' toast (driver.complete.queuedOverlay) — the PendingBadge communicates it is still sending; the queue replays + clears the store on successful send. CompletePage's old 'offline' branch replaced by 'queued'. (D15 i18n) added driver.position.stale, driver.queue.pending, driver.complete.queuedOverlay to BOTH cs.json + en.json; locales.parity green. NOTE: existing driver.complete.offlineHint is now unused by CompletePage but kept (no orphan-key lint; parity only checks key-set equality). PendingBadge/StalePositionBanner use role=status/alert + aria-live; all new interactive/status components carry an axe assertion. No api/** touched. Pre-staged api/ + .claude/ files from prior Lane A batches were left untouched; this session staged ONLY web/ + docs/driver-pwa-limits.md.
